title: Modern organic transformations: heterogeneous thermocatalysis or photocatalysis?
content:
Chem. Soc. Rev., 2025, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D2CS00097K, Tutorial Review
Ning Zhang, Wanbing Gong, Yujie Xiong
This review presents the working principles, advantages and disadvantages of heterogeneous thermo- and photocatalysis in organic transformations, and outlines the related applications and advancements of photocatalytic organic transformations.
